C0402.title: Slack Flaw Allowed Attackers to Force User Redirects and Steal Session Cookies
C0402.summary: In 2019, a HackerOne report disclosed an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in Slack that could be used for mass account takeover. The researcher explained that an attacker could force users into an attacker-controlled session flow and steal session cookies, enabling access to data shared in Slack workspaces; the report records that Slack fixed the issue after disclosure and paid a bounty.
